title: sarcoglyphis fimbriata
intro: Sarcoglyphis fimbriata, commonly known as the yellow helmet orchid, is a species of flowering plant in the family Orchidaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Sarcoglyphis fimbriata are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit neuroprotective properties, making it a potential treatment for various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
